projects.title: Reproducible Scientific Tables Course Project
bullets: Reproduced summary tables from raw public scientific inputs using Python and pandas as part of a supervised undergraduate team course project.
Wrote data-schema checks for the public scientific tables and recorded software dependencies used in processing.

projects.title: Short Text Classification Course Project
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for short public text documents using Python and scikit-learn in a supervised graduate course project.
Cleaned public text records using pandas and documented the training and test splits for classification.

research.title: Supervised Text Classification Research Assistance
bullets: Cleaned public text records using pandas as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research on short text classification.
Implemented a bag-of-words classifier using Python and scikit-learn for the classification of short public text documents.
